facts.text: Yinchorr was an Expansion Region location that housed one of the Galactic Empire's training hubs for the Emperor's Royal Guard.

evidence.quote: Yinchorr was an Expansion Region location that housed one of the Galactic Empire's training hubs for the Emperor's Royal Guard.

facts.text: In 3 ABY, it received an urgent transfer request for the capital, Coruscant, following a mass assassination of Royal Guards stationed there.
entities: Assassination of the Emperor's Royal Guard

evidence.quote: In 3 ABY, it received an urgent transfer request for the capital, Coruscant, following a mass assassination of Royal Guards stationed there.

facts.text: Yinchorr's control was contested by the New Republic in 4 ABY, leading to a siege situation.

evidence.quote: Yinchorr's control was contested by the New Republic in 4 ABY, leading to a siege situation.

facts.text: The location ended up in New Republic territory by 9 ABY.

evidence.quote: The location ended up in New Republic territory by 9 ABY.

facts.text: During the time of the Galactic Empire, Yinchorr housed one of the training hubs for the Emperor Palpatine's Royal Guard.

evidence.quote: During the time of the Galactic Empire, Yinchorr housed one of the training hubs for the Emperor Palpatine's Royal Guard.

facts.text: In 3 ABY, following the Crimson Dawn syndicate's mass assassination of the Royal Guard stationed at the Imperial Palace on the galactic capital Coruscant, an urgent order was made for additional personnel to be transferred from the Yinchorr Training Facility to Coruscant.
entities: Assassination of the Emperor's Royal Guard

evidence.quote: In 3 ABY, following the Crimson Dawn syndicate's mass assassination of the Royal Guard stationed at the Imperial Palace on the galactic capital Coruscant, an urgent order was made for additional personnel to be transferred from the Yinchorr Training Facility to Coruscant.

facts.text: It was noted in the file "Urgent transfer order #XJ8177," which was kept in the "Yinchorr Training Facility" section of the Imperial Archives.

evidence.quote: It was noted in the file "Urgent transfer order #XJ8177," which was kept in the "Yinchorr Training Facility" section of the Imperial Archives.

facts.text: In 4 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the recently reorganized New Republic, the latter faction fought to take Yinchorr from the Empire, the conflict devolving in to a siege situation.

evidence.quote: In 4 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the recently reorganized New Republic, the latter faction fought to take Yinchorr from the Empire, the conflict devolving in to a siege situation.

facts.text: The matters at Yinchorr were noted in a briefing on the progress of the war that was read by New Republic General Hera Syndulla.

evidence.quote: The matters at Yinchorr were noted in a briefing on the progress of the war that was read by New Republic General Hera Syndulla.

facts.text: The war ended in the Empire's fall in 5 ABY, and Yinchorr was within New Republic territory in 9 ABY.

evidence.quote: The war ended in the Empire's fall in 5 ABY, and Yinchorr was within New Republic territory in 9 ABY.

facts.text: The file on Urgent transfer order #XJ8177 was eventually uncovered by the historian Beaumont Kin, who wrote about Crimson Dawn's efforts against the Empire in his 35 ABY book The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire.
entities: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

evidence.quote: The file on Urgent transfer order #XJ8177 was eventually uncovered by the historian Beaumont Kin, who wrote about Crimson Dawn's efforts against the Empire in his 35 ABY book The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire.

entities: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 52
Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon

evidence.quote: In the end, the Empire slaughtered the Council, and the Yinchorri rebelled.
